description: Arrêts par lignes de transport en commun en Ile-de-France is a dataset listed in Open Data Conflans, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ile-de-France Mobilités. Liste des arrêts par ligne de transport. Cette donnée est issue de l'offre (GTFS). Coverage: Conflans-Sainte-Honorine. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Arrêts, Lignes, Bus. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-04-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (http://vvlibri.org/fr/licence/odbl-10/legalcode/unofficial). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ville-conflans-fr-portal.
